content.title: Tyler Perry’s "Divorced Sistas" Season 1 Part 2 – release date, schedule, how to watch
content.text: "Tyler Perry's Divorced Sistas" returns to Paramount+ on April 15 with the eight-episode conclusion to Season 1, which will debut with two episodes at launch, followed by new episodes weekly through Wednesday, May 27.Following five friends, Rasheda, Geneva, Naomi, Tiffany, and Bridgette, "Tyler Perry's Divorced Sistas" sees the group grapple with divorce, marriage, and dating, with this second part of Season 1 escalating the long-simmering tensions which erupt when relationships begin to fracture, and the consequences of past actions climax.Starring LeToya Luckett, Khadeen Indréa, Porscha Coleman, Briana Price, and Jennifer Sears, "Tyler Perry's Divorced Sistas" is created, directed, written and executive produced by Tyler Perry.(L-R): Jennifer Sears as Bridgette, Letoya Luckett-Coles as Rasheda, Khadeen Indréa as Geneva, Briana Price as Tiffany, and Porscha Coleman as Naomi i... | BET/Paramount+Tyler Perry's 'Divorced Sistas' Season 1 Episode 9 Release DateTyler Perry's "Divorced Sistas" Season 1, Episode 9 will be available to stream on Paramount+ on April 15, 2026.New episodes are releasing each Thursday through March 12, 2026.Tyler Perry's 'Divorced Sistas' Season 1 Episode 9 – How to WatchTyler Perry's "Divorced Sistas" Season 1, Episode 9 will be available to stream on Paramount+ from Midnight Pacific Time (PT)/3 am Eastern Time (ET) on April 15, 2026.A Paramount+ subscription is required to watch "Tyler Perry's Divorced Sistas". A Paramount+ Essential subscription costs $7.99 per month or $59 annually. Paramount+ also offers a Paramount+ with SHOWTIME-included plan for $12.99 per month or $119.99 annually. What Time Does Tyler Perry's 'Divorced Sistas' Season 1, Episode 9 Come Out?Tyler Perry's "Divorced Sistas" Season 1, Episode 9 will be available to stream on Paramount+ from Midnight (PT) on April 15, 2026/3 am Eastern Time (ET).With the Midnight Pacific Time release, new episodes are released on the same day worldwide. Here is when Episode 9 of Tyler Perry's "Divorced Sistas" will be available to stream in different time zones:April 15BRT: 4:00 amBST: 8:00 amCEST: 9:00 amIST: 12:30 pmJST: 4:00 pmAET: 6:00 pmNZDT: 8:00 pmTyler Perry's 'Divorced Sistas' Season 1, Episode 9 RuntimeTyler Perry's "Divorced Sistas" Season 1, Episode 9 does not yet have an official runtime. Previous episodes have run for 45 minutes.Tyler Perry's 'Divorced Sistas' Season 1 Part 2 Release ScheduleEpisode 9: April 15Episode 10: April 15Episode 11: April 22Episode 12: April 29Episode 13: May 6Episode 14: May 13Episode 15: May 20Episode 16: May 27What Will Happen in Tyler Perry's 'Divorced Sistas' Season 1 Part 2?The official synopsis for Tyler Perry's "Divorced Sistas," as per Paramount+, reads, "Tyler Perry's Divorced Sistas follows five friends, Rasheda, Geneva, Naomi, Tiffany, and Bridgette, as they battle life and relationship woes at some stage of divorce, marriage, and dating. But it's the battle within their circle that tests their true character and love for one another. The back half of Season 1 escalates the stakes as long-simmering tensions erupt, relationships fracture, and the consequences of past decisions come to a head."
